title: Reconcile Post-3.0.2 Evidence-Timestamp Hotfix and Development Identity

preflight.note: Recorded before reconciliation work begins. The earlier f2c80b7 runtime hotfix is explicitly historical input, not work retroactively claimed as preflight-governed.

acceptance_criteria.text: A durable evidence record reproduces the motivating future-evidence-timestamp defect, identifies commit f2c80b7dcdc54ff9f4753bc996ef0b6dfba539bf as a post-v3.0.2 runtime change that landed without a RepoPact work item or required post-release RELEASE_LABEL, and preserves that ordering without retroactive preflight claims.

The landed future-timestamp rule is reviewed as a generic RepoPact contract. A durable decision or equivalent governed rationale either retains it with explicit semantics for tolerance, timezone handling, deterministic diagnostics, and scope, or reverts it with rationale; the work does not merely accept the hotfix because it already landed.

If the runtime hotfix is retained, current main restores decision-0032 development identity with a valid VERSION-pinned RELEASE_LABEL at VERSION 3.0.2 and package metadata derives a distinct development version. If the hotfix is reverted so the package/runtime tree again matches v3.0.2, the absence of RELEASE_LABEL is proven valid instead.

Focused regression coverage proves the chosen timestamp semantics, including materially future timestamps, accepted clock-skew tolerance, timezone-aware values, and timezone-less values, plus at least one negative/control case showing ordinary historical/current evidence remains valid.

Relevant SPEC, tooling audit, findings/field evidence, and documentation surfaces are reconciled with the retained/reverted behavior without rewriting completed history. No frozen schema, invariant, or workflow change is made by WI049.

The final reconciled tree passes RepoPact validation, focused tests, the full unit suite, all conformance cases, dashboard/SPEC regeneration checks, and frozen-surface verification locally; WI032 remains blocked/local-only and no GitHub-hosted execution is used.

WI049 closes with concrete linked evidence, moves to work/completed, and is pushed with HEAD matching origin/main. VERSION remains 3.0.2, v3.0.2 remains unchanged, no stable release is cut, and WI044/WI046/WI047 remain unimplemented during this reconciliation.
